entries.description: Developing and maintaining business applications, backend services and deployment workflows while collaborating with a multidisciplinary team.
Contributed to the development of internal software solutions within an Agile environment, with a focus on backend features and application maintenance.
Mentoring first-year and second-year students in C, C++, Python, algorithms and software engineering while reviewing projects and helping them solve technical challenges.
Discovered professional mobile development practices while contributing to internal development tasks and gaining experience in collaborative projects.
